hooks.command:
echo `# <#` >/dev/null
sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/wake.sh" claude session-start; exit $?
#> > $null
powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/wake.ps1" claude session-start; exit $LASTEXITCODE

echo `# <#` >/dev/null
sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/wake.sh" claude wait; exit $?
#> > $null
powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/wake.ps1" claude wait; exit $LASTEXITCODE
